display.title: {"text": "II. Workshop"}
description: &6STATION II&r  Run a Create press line, press Survey Plates, add a construction station and bring back a find from a dungeon, temple or wreck.
&eWhy:&r Production at home: better building reach, a supply crate every day and real processing instead of hand crafting.
&7- Make sheets with a Mechanical Press&r
&7- A Mechanical Press stands at the station&r
&7- A depot, basin or belt feeds the press&r
&7- Place a schematic table or crafting table (construction station)&r
&7- Enter a dungeon, temple, ocean ruin or arcane site&r
&eUnlocks:&r An iron Construction Stick, Create's schematic tools, a millstone and fan for ore processing, and the daily Supply Crate service.
&7Commission it from the charter panel. This quest completes by itself when the station records it.&r
&6You get:&r Expedition Hall: prepare for, and finish, two of three regional expeditions.
